# ChatGPT science and strategy review — Batch C (2026-11-04)
Reviewed PR #132 exact HEAD `00a3fdb3b7fb16de7215c068e7efc3720e75c2a0`: `README.md`, `CLIMATE_EVENT_REGISTER.json`, `CLIMATE_INDEX_CONTEXT.json`, `COOMA_PUBLIC_AUDIT.md`, `EVIDENCE_MATRIX.md`, `PROTOCOL_AND_QUALITY.md`, `FACILITY_FOLLOWUP.json`, `SOURCES.json`, `FAILURES_AND_GAPS.json`, `NEXT_SESSION.md`, validation receipt, PR and CI metadata.

**Disposition: ACCEPT_WITH_LIMITS as evidence preparation only. NOT scientific admission. No experiment authorized.** Six BOM summary values are recorded with station IDs, named temporal support (single day, calendar year, calendar month), units, null QC/completeness/UTC and blocked facility joins. Distinctions are correctly retained: 37.9°C Cooma Jan 16 2019 and 41.5°C Rockhampton Nov 25 2018 are daily maxima, *not verified heatwaves or reactor temperatures*; 2019 totals Cooma 318.6mm and Rockhampton 295.8mm are low-rainfall year context, *not site water deficit or established drought onset/end*; Cooma Jun 6 2016 86.0mm is labelled daily station rain, not landfill inundation; Rockhampton March 2017 409.4mm is a monthly total, *not Tropical Cyclone Debbie daily storm rainfall*. This is a check of archive semantics, **not** my independent QC/raw time-series reconstruction.

2018/2019 ENSO/IOD/SAM summaries are retrospective context, not event-time forecasts or emissions multipliers. 2019 year-end phase cannot be applied to January 2019. 2016–2017 numerical index series absent. Atmospheric station vs physical facility vs reactor water/core temperature remain separate spatial/physical supports.

Cooma EPL 6194 dated 2017-03-15 is evidence of a historical licence-to-premises relationship; not proof of current licence, operator, status, site geometry or gas capture/flux. Old closure notices are operational history, not meteorological measurements or current performance. Three inherited Rockhampton candidates remain PARTIAL; Cooma becomes a fourth PARTIAL candidate, no national census. Exact physical-site coordinates, process measurements, gas data, verified event QC and time conversion are missing. Do not fabricate missing values, turn null into zero, or spatial-join a weather station point to a facility with unknown geometry.

Source summaries and package SHA attest research-derivative bytes, not raw original official webpages. Structural/mobile browser QA reported PASS for 20 combinations, but **no GitHub CI checks/workflow runs were returned**. P1-A scientific gate PENDING, PR132 DRAFT/NOT_MERGED/NOT_DEPLOYED.

**Recommended next bounded batch C2 (non-numerical):** (a) prioritize only one or two public primary BOM daily record sets/quality metadata to clarify source time support, observation convention, station moves and completeness for an exemplar Cooma/Rockhampton event; (b) choose and justify pre-specified event definitions/lag candidate ranges without using gas outcomes; (c) assemble a *measurement-readiness matrix* of what genuine landfill/lagoon measurements are necessary to connect gas flux and operating controls, with source discovery/permissions rather than estimated results; (d) identify one earliest viable public data experiment candidate only as a proposal, with deterministic stop gates; (e) update GitHub source receipts, canonical index, NEXT_SESSION and paginated Slides. Avoid endless micro-search of inaccessible facilities; if source absent, explicitly STOP and keep research progressing at protocol level. No new numerical emissions or model runs, site climate effect, forecasts presented as observations, legal accounting outputs, national estimates, Council-private data, PR merge, deployment or scientific promotion.

**CRP:** knowledge—time windows, observation/QC, physical site and reactor conditions differ; ideas—event-aligned quality evidence and measurement readiness; decision—C evidence preparation ACCEPT_WITH_LIMITS, science pending, C2 recommended; open—BOM raw QC, facility spatial geometry, process/gas series, climate thresholds; next—bounded C2; keywords—ClimateOS/CarbonOS/AWT/BOM/CH4/N2O/CO2/ENSO/GIS/MRV.
